column4: A single strong gust of autumn wind sweeping across an open meadow and through a pine forest: it rises from nothing, roars through the branches and dry leaves for a moment and dies away. Outdoors, no rain, no music, no voices.
A long gust of wind rushing through tall spruce trees, the needles hissing and the trunks groaning softly, building up and fading away. Outdoors, far and wide, no rain, no music.
A short sharp blast of wind past the ear, a whoosh with dry leaves and grit skittering along the ground. Close, outdoors, no rain, no music.
A violent storm gust howling through a forest in heavy rain: a deep roar rising, branches thrashing and cracking, rain lashing sideways, then easing off. Outdoors, no thunder, no music.
A tall old tree trunk creaking and groaning as it bends in a strong wind, a slow wooden creak, close by in a forest. Outdoors, no music, no voices.
